data.body:
Phase 1 confirmed root cause: 103 non-fixture test-local/helper subprocess environments are ordinary broad mappings constructed from `os.environ` (51 `dict(...)`, 49 mapping spreads, 10 `.copy()` across the full 110-site AST census, minus the seven decorated fixtures owned by dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran). When process startup raises, pytest 9 long traceback argument rendering applies `saferepr` to `subprocess.run` kwargs, `Popen.env`, and `_execute_child.env`; an ordinary mapping therefore serializes inherited values. A controlled runtime probe with a first-position synthetic sentinel produced four sentinel occurrences under default `--tb=long`, while `--tb=short` produced none; a late sentinel was truncated, proving insertion order can mask the defect. Application stdout/stderr was not involved.

Discriminating boundary experiments confirmed a mutable `dict` subclass with redacted `__repr__` preserves exact subprocess semantics while removing this carrier: a real child received and printed the exact sentinel, default-long startup failure contained zero sentinel occurrences, and nonzero-exit/timeout traces stayed clean with and without `--showlocals`. Rewrapping it with `dict(...)` restored four leaks, so the guard must prohibit both new broad constructors and boundary unwrapping. On POSIX startup failure, explicit `--showlocals` still exposes the stdlib local `env_list` of encoded `KEY=value` bytes; representation safety is therefore scoped to the ticket-reported default-long carrier, not claimed as universal traceback sanitization. The existing repository invariant at `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py:13-45` and commit 034e17209c makes legitimacy `defect`.

History/blame shows the construct arrived through many independent features (representatives: `tests/interfaces/store/test_updated_at.py:30` commit 0ecf0198, `tests/_store_isolation.py:30` commit d98a2ce7, `tests/integration/test_init_fail_closed.py:65` commit af83a069e), not one regression. Ambient inheritance is genuinely required on some surfaces (`tests/_store_isolation.py:30-48`; the live Jira commentary at `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_reconcile_pass.py:139-143`), ruling out one global allowlist. Expected repair: route all 103 in-scope constructions through one representation-safe, mutable mapping that preserves keys/values/order and returns the safe type from `.copy()`, plus an AST guard that skips the separately-owned decorated fixtures and rejects raw construction or unwrapping. Caller/dependency sweep: callers consume mapping operations or pass the value to subprocess; the successful-child experiment proves compatibility, and no caller contract requires ordinary-dict repr. No production/maintenance environment path changes.
